items.one_liner: Use AnyJev to attach closed-form classification heads to truncated LLMs via vLLM, getting real decision probabilities without token generation.
items.summary: AnyJev is an open-source tool that converts any large language model into a calibrated decision model without retraining by appending a closed-form head to truncated model layers. By serving models like Qwen2.5-7B via vLLM and reading hidden states directly from a pooling server, users can process typed decisions such as multiple-choice classifications with real probabilities. items.bottom_line: AnyJev allows developers to bypass full LLM text generation and extract calibrated, typed decision probabilities directly from hidden states using a lightweight linear head.
